states: Production Docs consumes actual shipped release/disclosure markdown, router, renderer, header and CSS in an isolated evidence-only mount. This is not an authenticated shell or patch-operation/release/recovery proof.
Unavailable stable-patch delivery is explicit and dated; eligible current-stable fixes differ from candidate regressions and all-main minor scope. A patch cannot restart the weekly minor clock.
No new product route or navigation entry. No preview/downgrade or unsafe repeat is required for a stable report.
57 assertions, four actual guide GETs, no page exceptions or mutation/off-origin requests, no page-wide overflow. Playwright 1.56.1 matches the integration lock.

All six captures natively opened and inspected. Desktop and narrow copy wraps without clipping, linked heading focus is visible and the complete phone policy list is readable. A viewport screenshot can end within later content; the full policy element capture supplies the remainder.
interactions: Desktop keyboard focus and Enter follow the disclosure link to the release-guide patch heading without a document reload.
Touch WebKit follows the same link and focuses the actual target heading.
Read both complete amended paragraphs and patch-status/eligibility/timing guidance at desktop and narrow widths.
